profile.headline: Graphic | Multimedia | Web | Instructional Design
profile.summary: With 23 years of experience at UNC Wilmington, overseeing websites for the Watson College of Education has been a key responsibility. This includes the main site and affiliated programs like MarineQuest, CESTEM, and DC Virgo, ensuring each platform remains engaging, accessible, and aligned with college branding and strategic goals. Additionally, promotional materials are designed and produced, including posters, advertisements, banners, and digital assets, along with the development of coordinated marketing and social media campaigns. The college’s presence on Facebook, BlueSky, YouTube, LinkedIn, and Instagram were also managed, and the Sayed Building digital signage displays were overseen to support timely and effective communication.

positions.title: Graphic Designer/ Multimedia/Web Developer/Marketing Communications
positions.description:
Served through an array of cross-functional roles, including creative director, lead designer, social media manager, content developer, and marketing communications specialist. Oversaw all facets of digital, social, and traditional media including marketing, collateral, and publication design. Administered technical support and training on computers, eLearning best practices, classroom equipment, LMS/CMS software, instructional design, and website content management.

• Spearheaded website redesign for Watson College through analytics analysis.
• Implemented social media campaign that increased followers by 500% in the first year. 
• Designed digital ad campaigns that increased graduate enrollment by 7% in two months, which resulted in increased enrollment and UNCW graduating from a non-research campus to an R-2 campus.
• Redesigned Watson College branding and started a t-shirt initiative that has delivered over 10,000 shirts to alumni around the world, which is represented on social media by our highly successful #WatsonWednesdays posts.

projects.title: #TeachingMatters and #ItBeginsWithTeachers Ad and Social Media Campaigns
projects.description:
The #TeachingMatters campaign, held on National Teacher Appreciation Day, encouraged UNCW faculty, staff and students as well as WCE’s school partners and members of the community to post short videos or written messages about why teaching matters to a common Twitter hashtag. 

After #TeachingMatters, Watson followed up with a digital ad and TV commercial campaign called "It Begins With Teachers" to highlight stories from community members about their teachers or teaching experiences, tagged as #ItBeginsWithTeachers. To reflect our leadership programs, Watson has also integrated #ItBeginsWithLeaders into the campaign.

projects.title: #WatsonWednesdays campaign
projects.description:
Starting in 2015, Watson College developed a t-shirt campaign to highlight the college and teaching community. Alumni, faculty and staff were all given long sleeve t-shirts to wear on Wednesdays at the University, their schools, or anywhere our alumni were present. 

This campaign has been a 10 year success with over 5,000 t-shirts given to the community. Our social media posts reflect alumni and partners from all over the world, including Amsterdam, Ethiopia, Ireland, Japan, etc. Watson is now a recognizable symbol in the community and around the globe!
